title: Stop waiting for the right time
summary: The right time appears only when remembrance begins now. Begin now before planning becomes another delay.
takeaway: Begin now before planning becomes another delay.
lifeApplication: When practice is postponed by timing, start one true minute now and let remembrance make the time truthful.
